steps.content: Then the red crystals rupture. Before your eyes, their glow peels away, and with it, the presence that has coiled inside you since the beginning finally recedes.
You are waking now. Leaving this world. Leaving the nightmare behind.
You almost step forward. Then your periphery catches something. At the edge of the dispersing ruins, two silhouettes stand in silence.
Their faces remain hidden. You cannot tell if they watch you, if they even see you at all. Yet something stops you cold. Familiarity. Deep and wordless and undeniable.

One of them tilts their head ever so slightly and murmurs something indistinct. The words escape you. But the voice... the voice echoes somewhere beneath thought, in the place where recognition lives before understanding.
The bell fades. The world dissolves. When you open your eyes again, only a heavy memory remains.

steps.speaker: Shin?
steps.content: Go on... Go back to your struggle. You'll return. You always do. You can't stay away...

steps.speaker: Shin?
steps.content: ...This city... lives in all of you.
